description: Read-only aggregate for one durable dispatch. Returns ledger state and causal version; current attempt/model/runtime/host; first-turn transport evidence; last ACK and milestone timestamps/ages; native host_liveness=alive|dead|unknown with observation detail and persisted bounded next-probe/escalation obligations; uptake/report/watchdog/TTL deadlines and overdue flags; failed-start, blocker, worker-completion, and independent-acceptance evidence; rejected-event count; exact next_required_action and responsible_role; and raw first-turn receipts as subordinate audit detail. It derives the current overdue condition without resolving it, including deduplicated failed-start decisions, watchdog review, liveness re-probe/escalation, blocker, acceptance, uptake, milestone, and TTL conditions. A status read never advances state or suppresses a notice. plan_projection_warning states that human coordinator plans are unverified projections of durable state, not an input to it.
embedding_description: Read the authoritative state of one managed worker lane and the exact decision owed now: attempt and runtime, transport versus ACK, native liveness, deadlines, blocker, completion validation, causal version, next action, and owner. Use after reconnect or handover instead of trusting a stale plan or routing receipt.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: A decision-oriented managed_dispatch aggregate plus rejected-event count, raw transport receipts, deadline-overdue flags, event ages, state consistency, and any current overdue condition.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with state, dispatch/current attempt identity, host_liveness, causal version, overdue condition, next_required_action, and responsible_role. Keep raw receipts subordinate. Say unknown liveness is unknown, completion_reported awaits coordinator acceptance, and completed proves only dispatch acceptance.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads the managed_dispatch row and its append-only event rows through StateManagementInterface, derives ages/deadline flags/current condition, and performs no authoritative transition.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: dispatch_not_found means no non-deleted managed_dispatch row matches the supplied dispatch_id. state_service_unavailable means the state service is not bound. A successful read with unknown host liveness is honest evidence, not a transport failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm dispatch_id from dispatch_managed_work or the coordinator handoff. For a returned condition, perform the named report/resolve action with the current causal version; repeated status reads do not satisfy it.
